headlines.title: 당정 " 메가특구법 연내 처리 …미래대응기금 신설"
headlines.summary: (사진=연합뉴스) 더불어민주당과 정부가 3대 메가프로젝트 지원을 위한 메가특구특별법을 올해 안에 처리하기로 했다. 한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 13일 국회에서 2026 경제성장전략 당정협의에서 "메가특구특별법과 전략수출금융지원법 등 주요 입법을 연말까지 처리하겠다"고 강조했다.

headlines.summary: [더불어민주당 한정애 정책위의장이 13일 국회 의원회관에서 열린 2026 하반기 경제성장전략 당정 협의에서 인사말을 하고 있다. (사진=연합뉴스)] 더불어민주당과 정부는 올 하반기 3대 메가프로젝트(반도체·데이터센터·피지컬AI)를 속도감 있게 추진하는 데 역량을 모으기로 했습니다.

headlines.title: 내일 부동산 토론회 도 ‘ 규제 ’에 초점… ‘공급 확대’ 없인 피해 떠안...

headlines.title: “ 규제로 집값 잡힐까 ”… 릴레이 토론·업무보고 ‘ 정책 슈퍼위크 ’ [부...

headlines.title: 경기도에 ‘ 첫 집 ’ 2030 1년새 1만명 증가
headlines.summary: 서울 집값급등에 부담 덜한 수도권행 경기 생초 매수 60.2%, 1년만 24% 늘어 성남시 수정구 216→1187명, 450% ↑ 동탄 첫집 마련 3328명 경기도 최다 올해 경기도에서 ‘내 집 마련’에 나선 매수자 열 중 여섯은 2030 청년들로 나타났다.

headlines.title: ‘나이 30에도 부모에 얹혀산다’… 집값에 갇힌 2030 청년들

headlines.title: 무주택 신혼부부 내집마련 , 5년 전보다 5.4년 더 걸렸다

headlines.title: 7월 1~10일 수출 298억달러 ‘ 최대 ’ … 반도체 호황에도 장비업계는 ‘...

headlines.title: 휘발유 공급가 인하 16일째 … 따라내린 주유소 18%뿐

headlines.title: 정부, 중동 정세 긴장 고조에 원유 수급 긴급점검
headlines.summary: 원유 수급상황 긴급 점검회의 산업통상부 제공 사진 최근 이란의 호르무즈 재봉쇄 발표와 미군의 이란 공습 등으로 중동정세 긴장이 다시 고조되자 정부가 원유 수급상황을 긴급 점검했습니다. 산업통상부 문신학 차관은 오늘(13일) 오전 원유 수급상황 긴급 점검회의를 열고, 유조선 통항상황을 비롯한 원유 수급상황을 점검했습니다.

headlines.title: ‘ 콩나물 콩 ’ TRQ 1만t 증량

headlines.title: 폭염·호우 땐 공공계약 공사 중단 … 재경부 업무 처리 지침 안내

key_headlines.title: July 1-10 Exports Reach Record $29.8 Billion, but Domestic Equipment Industry Faces Headwinds
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's early July exports reached a historic monthly pace exceeding $100 billion, driven by the semiconductor boom. However, increased overseas equipment imports are reducing domestic semiconductor equipment orders.

key_headlines.title: Young Adults Trapped by Housing Costs: Nearly 1 Million Households of 30-Year-Olds Living with Parents
key_headlines.summary: Rising apartment prices and tight rental markets are preventing young adults from achieving independence, with nearly 1 million households of 30-year-olds cohabiting with parents. This generational wealth gap driven by real estate threatens to evolve into Japan-style economic problems.

key_headlines.title: Government Launches Real Estate Policy Super Week with Tax and Regulation Overhaul
key_headlines.summary: From July 14-23, the government will hold relay policy forums on real estate, culminating in a presidential national debate on July 23. Major changes to property taxes, transaction taxes, and financing regulations are expected to be announced.

key_headlines.title: 24-Hour Foreign Exchange Trading Launches Successfully with Reduced Volatility
key_headlines.summary: After one week of operation, Korea's 24-hour foreign exchange trading shows stable performance with daily volatility declining from 11.6% to 8.5%. The reform reduces market gaps and improves trading continuity.

key_headlines.title: Record Budget of Over 800 Trillion Won Planned for Next Year on Semiconductor Windfall
key_headlines.summary: With semiconductor boom generating record tax revenues exceeding initial forecasts of 412 trillion won, the government plans unprecedented fiscal expansion. Additional resources will be directed toward investments in youth policies, regional development, and education.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is riding a semiconductor export boom, with July's first 10 days already setting a record pace exceeding $100 billion in monthly exports. However, this strength masks emerging challenges: the domestic semiconductor equipment industry is suffering as companies import more overseas equipment, and young adults are increasingly unable to afford independent housing despite economic growth. The government is responding with a comprehensive real estate policy overhaul launching this week, signaling major reforms to taxes and lending regulations.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government is planning a record-breaking budget of over 800 trillion won for next year, fueled by semiconductor export windfall revenues that substantially exceed initial projections. Fiscal authorities are undertaking a major structural review, including a 54-year overhaul of the education finance allocation system and expanded youth support programs. International economists report recession probabilities are declining despite geopolitical tensions, though inflation concerns remain moderate.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI index experienced volatility in mid-July, declining to the 7,400 level as international oil prices surged following U.S. policy announcements on Iran. Chinese technology-focused ETFs have gained investor attention during KOSPI weakness, with expectations rising for upcoming Chinese semiconductor company listings. The Bank of Korea is likely to raise its base rate on July 16, signaling a shift in monetary policy direction.
sections.Industry & Technology: Samsung and LG are pursuing divergent strategies in the energy storage system (ESS) market, with Samsung focusing on battery cell sales while LG expands into power grid management. The automotive industry is transitioning from traditional vehicle sales models to subscription services for batteries, tires, and autonomous driving features. Battery technology advances, particularly in lithium-sulfur batteries and catalyst optimization, are accelerating energy storage capabilities.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices have reached record levels, with the gap between purchase and jeonse (long-term lease) prices widening to nearly 900 million won, requiring substantial capital for renters to transition to homeownership. The government's policy super week aims to address supply constraints, with discussions on relaxing regulations for reconstruction projects and expanding non-apartment housing. However, concerns persist that regulatory-focused policies may further restrict housing supply and worsen affordability for younger generations.
sections.International Economy: U.S. President Trump announced a blockade on Iran and toll charges for Hormuz Strait shipping, causing global oil prices to surge nearly 10 percent and triggering stock market declines, particularly in tech indices. Federal Reserve officials signaled potential rate increases if core inflation persists, with market expectations for policy tightening rising amid geopolitical tensions. International crude oil volatility is creating uncertainty for monetary policy decisions at the upcoming FOMC meeting on July 28-29.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korea's data center market is emerging as a key alternative investment asset class, driven by expanding AI demand, constrained supply, and global capital inflows. However, AI adoption is paradoxically reducing entry-level hiring in IT service companies despite rising revenues, signaling a shift in workforce strategy toward experienced talent. The government emphasizes AI data centers as critical infrastructure, positioning physical AI infrastructure development as a mega-project essential for future industrial competitiveness.
sections.Others: International crude oil prices surged approximately 10 percent following geopolitical tensions over Iran, impacting global financial markets and inflation expectations. Financial regulators are intensifying oversight of leveraged ETFs and directing asset management firms to eliminate misleading advertising and manage pricing discrepancies. Volkswagen faces mounting challenges from reduced U.S. EV sales and strong Korean labor union positions, potentially opening opportunities for Hyundai Motor in global markets.
